title: salvia lavandulifolia var. approximata
intro: Salvia lavandulifolia var. approximata, commonly known as Woodland Blue Sage, is a plant species within the Salvia genus. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and other sleep disorders due to its calming effects. The bioactive constituents of Woodland Blue Sage include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as sedation, anti-anxiety, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's health benefits include its potential to reduce stress, promote relaxation, and improve overall well-being.
